1000 Forms of Fear is the sixth studio album by Australian singer Sia.
It was released on 4 July 2014 by Monkey Puzzle and RCA Records worldwide, and Inertia Records in Australia.
Primarily an electropop album, the record also incorporates influences from reggae and hip hop.
Sia Kate Isobelle Furler (  SEE-ə; born 18 December 1975) is an Australian singer and songwriter.
Born and raised in Adelaide, she started her career as a singer in the acid jazz band Crisp in the mid-1990s.
When Crisp disbanded in 1997, she released her debut studio album, OnlySee, in Australia.
